lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: Today's cases are all mixed up. Some are dangerous, too.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: The last chapter is open: Escalation & Safety. Knowing your limits is the mark of a great technician.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: If a laptop acts strangely, don't clean it yourself. Disconnect it from the network and hand it to Mbak Rani's SOC team.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: The strange laptop is with the SOC team now. Mbak Rani says it's lucky you didn't delete anything.

lines.speaker: kelabu
lines.text: ...Too careful for a technician. How annoying.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: You've earned the title of IT Workshop technician. Drop by anytime!
